{{Quote|Son, if one hostage is good, two are better, and three, well, that's just good business!|Hondo Ohnaka, quoting his mother|audio=HondoQuotesMother-TGG.flac|<ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>}}
Hondo Ohnaka's '''mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] that sold her [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|son]] into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].

==Biography==
She lived on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] during Hondo's childhood. She and [[Hondo Ohnaka's father|her husband]] were poor swindlers and they sold Hondo as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] to "honor" the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] god [[Quay]].<ref name="TCW Ultimate Battles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref>

Somehow, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] still held his mother in high regard and quoted her on occasion. Based on this salute to her, she was deceased by the time [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang]] kidnapped [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="The Gungan General" />
